correctness.rationale: The explicit 24-word code has pairwise disjoint distinct deletion shadows. The 81 rational output weights encoded with denominator 14 have numerator sum 348, and exhaustive integer replay verifies every one of the 243 input words has deletion-shadow numerator weight at least 14. Therefore any code has size at most floor(348/14)=24, matching the construction.
